correlation_rules.run_identity: Every usable record must exact-match run ID, scenario ID, snapshot digest, profile digest, marker digest, and marker byte length.
correlation_rules.causal_id: A qualifying SDK attempt retains one bounded framework run ID. Missing, duplicate, or conflicting causal IDs are explicit issues.
correlation_rules.marker_digest: Poison, SDK activity input, and safe-sink evidence must bind the same synthetic marker SHA-256 and byte length. Raw marker bytes are absent.
correlation_rules.bounded_order: The qualified Mastra descriptor establishes recordingTool ActivityStarted as pre-effect; the correlator never infers causality from wall-clock proximity.
correlation_rules.complete_observation: Runtime coverage, exact service readiness, path-free sandbox probe binding, successful bounded process exit, exact cleanup object binding, and non-inconclusive bodies must all be present without ambiguity or contradiction.

adversarial_matrix.duplicate_identical: duplicate_evidence and duplicate_sink_receipt ambiguity; complete observation absent
adversarial_matrix.clock_skew: fact presence unchanged; volatile timestamp omitted and never used

limits: Correlation is a pure function over immutable normalized objects and assigns no security outcome, confidence, or reachability.
Baseline correlation cannot emit OpenBox BLOCK or SDK-applied-BLOCK facts; Phase 07 alone can supply that real governed evidence.
The native sandbox preflight proves sandbox posture, not a project-effect denial. No sandbox_prevented fact is fabricated from the preflight probe.
No Docker code, driver, fallback, or execution is present.
